items.html: And the matter is that that great illumination is pure myrrh, utterly clear and clean, which passes from the mouth of the Yesod of the Nukva outward. And this is the secret of the verse, "and my hands dripped with passing myrrh." By this you will understand the greatness of Mordechai, who rose to the aspect of Malchut and became the viceroy to the king. And this is the secret of the verse, "and Mordechai went out from before the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and a great crown of gold."
